name: Zach Jones - Psyops Czar
text:
PRESIDENT TRUMP CONFIRMS THAT ALL THE POLITICAL POLLS ARE FAKE

MIRANDA DEVINE: “So the polls are saying that there's going to be a landslide defeat for the Republicans. So it's either they're right or it's the biggest polling error in history. Are you confident the polls are wrong?”

DONALD TRUMP: “Well, they said I was going to do great this last time, and I did. So they were right about that, more or less. But they were wrong on the second time I won. It was a rigged election. And the first time they had Hillary Clinton winning pretty easily. And I won. I won pretty easily. Won pretty much everything. So, yeah, they're— I think they're rigged. I think a lot of pollsters don't even send pollsters out. I think they collect a big check. They say they have 1,000 pollsters all over the country and then they sit back behind a desk. And this is just my opinion.”

MIRANDA DEVINE: “And do you think Republicans don't answer the polls?”

DONALD TRUMP: “I also think that. So yesterday we had a big rally in South Carolina for Lindsey Graham's sister, who's a fantastic person, actually, Darlene. And I think she's going to do well. Again, I did one for her, and I think hopefully she'll be in good shape. But I asked the question. There were a lot of people, thousands and thousands. And I said, who in this room was polled? About 2 people raised their hand. I mean, I've never been polled. I don't know anybody that's ever been polled. And yet the pollsters come out with numbers. Maybe they don't poll Republicans. But I mean, I think we're going to do pretty well. I do that based on the rallies. The rallies are as big as they've ever been.”

*It’s psychological warfare. The news may be fake but the war for your mind is very real.*
